LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 11.1.1 INTERVIEWS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 11
Topic 11.1: Listening and Speaking 11.1.1 Interviews
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 11.1.1 Interviews, part of Strand 11 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade seven ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why are interviews important? 2. How can one seek clarification during an interview? 3. How does one prepare for an interview?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 11.1.1 Interviews together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: A learner discuss in groups reasons for sitting for a placement and scholarship

interview.

● Digital Literacy: A learner searches online and watch video clips on school placement and scholarship interviews.

● Self-efficacy: A learner organise and lead the open forum where the functional reading is conducted.

Values:
● Responsibility is achieved through role play and discussion.

● Respect: A learner collaborates in groups.

Link to other subjects:

Kiswahili: A learner relates the concept of interviews to the learning of conversational skills in Kiswahili
